title: A First-Order Learning Algorithm for Online Resource Allocation with Constant Regret
abstract: arXiv:2609.05895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a finite-horizon online resource allocation problem with initial resource capacities proportional to the horizon. In each period, a request type is observed and one action is chosen from a finite menu. Each action earns a reward and consumes a vector of resources. The arrival types are independent and identically distributed, but their probabilities are unknown. We present a primal first-order learning policy that, in each period, performs one gradient ascent update of the action coordinates associated with the current request type. The policy achieves $O(1)$ expected additive regret relative to the hindsight optimum, with a bound independent of the horizon $T$. It does not solve any linear program, and the regret bound does not require a nondegeneracy assumption on the fluid linear program.

translated_title: 一种具有常数后悔的在线资源分配一阶学习算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个有限时域的在线资源分配问题，其中初始资源容量与时域长度成比例。在每个周期，会观察到一种请求类型，并从有限的动作菜单中选择一个动作。每个动作会获得一份奖励并消耗一个资源向量。请求到达类型是独立同分布的，但其概率是未知的。我们提出了一种原始一阶学习策略，在每个周期中，仅对与当前请求类型相关的动作坐标执行一次梯度上升更新。该策略实现了相对于事后最优解的 O(1) 期望加性后悔，且该后悔界与时域长度 T 无关。该策略不需要求解任何线性规划，并且其后悔界不要求流体线性规划满足非退化假设。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需求解线性规划的一阶学习策略，在请求到达概率未知的在线资源分配问题中实现了与时域长度无关的常数期望后悔界。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a primal first-order learning policy that achieves a constant expected regret bound independent of the horizon T in online resource allocation with unknown arrival-type probabilities, without solving any linear program.
